+"""Record preparation steps."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def validate_record(record: object) -> tuple[str, Any, bool]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return its trimmed key, value and enabled flag.
+
+    Raises ValueError for anything that is not a valid record.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(record, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare_with(record: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a new prepared record whose display is ``render(value)``.
+
+    The input record is never mutated.
+    """
+    key, value, enabled = validate_record(record)
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": render(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``value`` is a coroutine function or async generator function."""
+    return is_async_function(value)
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Prepare ``record`` with an async-function detection display."""
+    return prepare_with(record, display_async)

@@ -44,3 +44,18 @@ def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
 def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Prepare ``record`` with an async-function detection display."""
     return prepare_with(record, display_async)
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {item['key']!r}")
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared
